subject.title: [Bug]: 2026.6.x regression cascade — memory search broken, then sessions lost on every reconnect (multi-agent deployment broken)

question: Should this umbrella remain the canonical tracker for the remaining memory/session/config cascade, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical issues now that the QMD zero-hit and no-intent WebChat creation slices are fixed?
rationale: The remaining report spans multiple subsystems and includes new UX/config proposals; automation cannot decide whether to keep one umbrella or split product-owned follow-ups.

options.title: Keep umbrella and split linked subissues
options.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-visible incident tracker while opening or linking narrower fixes for memory routing, reconnect proof, history recovery, and config crash reproduction.

options.title: Make a narrower issue canonical
options.body: Close this only after a maintainer creates or chooses one canonical follow-up that preserves the unresolved deployment evidence.

options.title: Close after live repro fails
options.body: Run a current-release/live multi-agent repro first and close only if the cascade no longer reproduces and open related PRs are not needed.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and split linked subissues
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the maintainer-visible incident tracker while opening or linking narrower fixes for memory routing, reconnect proof, history recovery, and config crash reproduction.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current history signal for the merged Control UI session-intent repair and adjacent memory work named in this issue.
